tool_args.rationale: The quadratic surface failed fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.106 > 0.045), indicating that a generic polynomial was not an adequate mechanism. The data span u_now and s_grad, include an open-branch measurement, and match the two-layer siphon source family; fitting its three parameters numerically is a parsimonious next model without buying a probe unsupported by the current horizon or regime.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its note is for memory ODE identification requiring at least eight trajectory rows; current evidence and task signatures support a static siphon response, so this higher-cost probe is not yet justified.
All supplied rows use H=0.6 and the observed pilot signatures indicate a smooth monotone response; horizon reversal is not currently evidenced.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit barrier-modulated siphon or cooperative Hill inhibition
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These are plausible smooth alternatives, but the two-layer siphon with a positive open-branch term is the closest source-note family and has only three free parameters for six observations.
No high-frequency oscillation or other evidence of non-stationarity is present.
